name: supportgpt_phase1_golden
description: Synthetic offline evaluation cases grounded only in the project's seeded knowledge base.

cases.query: I paid for my subscription 10 days ago. Can I request a billing refund?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. Under refund policy v1, billing refund requests may be filed within 30 days of the initial subscription payment, provided the account has no active dispute.

cases.query: Is my account eligible for a refund while an active billing dispute is still open?
cases.reference_answer: No. Refund policy v1 says refunds are eligible only for accounts with no active disputes.

cases.query: After a v1 refund is approved, when should it appear on my bank statement?
cases.reference_answer: An approved v1 refund should appear on the customer's bank statement within 3 to 5 business days.

cases.query: I bought the service 50 days ago. Does refund policy v2 still allow a request?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. Refund policy v2 allows requests up to 60 days from purchase.

cases.query: Does the v2 corporate refund policy deduct a processing fee?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. A 5% processing fee is deducted from all v2 refund requests.

cases.query: Where is a v2 refund sent and how long does it take to clear?
cases.reference_answer: The refund is sent to the original payment card and takes 3 to 5 business days to clear.

cases.query: Our API returns 504 Gateway errors. What should technical support verify first?
cases.reference_answer: Technical support should verify the backup routing cluster.

cases.query: Which region hosts the fallback API cluster used during connectivity timeouts?
cases.reference_answer: The fallback API cluster is in the AWS us-east-1 region.

cases.query: What client-side action is required after API routing switches to the fallback cluster?
cases.reference_answer: Clear client caches after the routing switch to restore service.

cases.query: Where do I go to update my customer account preferences?
cases.reference_answer: Navigate to Settings, then Preferences, then Profile.

cases.query: How do I update and verify the email address in my account profile?
cases.reference_answer: Update the verification email under Settings, Preferences, Profile, then click the validation link sent to the inbox.

cases.query: What must I do before API key access is enabled for my account?
cases.reference_answer: Click the validation link sent to the verification email inbox to enable API key access.
